POP series

POP Series 4

Released August 1, 2006 · 17 cards

POP Series 4 is a Pokémon TCG expansion in the POP series, released in English on August 1, 2006. It has 17 cards. It includes 14 Pokémon, 1 Trainer and 2 Energy cards, and is not legal in Standard or Expanded.

Illustrators

10 illustrators worked on POP Series 4. Most cards: Masakazu Fukuda (3), Atsuko Nishida (2), Hisao Nakamura (2), Kouki Saitou (2), Mitsuhiro Arita (2), Takumi Akabane (2), Hiromichi Sugiyama (1), Kagemaru Himeno (1).
